content: NOVELTY_CALIBRATION inputs: 19/20 frames retained at thr=0.65 = ~95% (far above 5-25% band). Scores observed in sample of 10: 0.6 (n=2), 0.7 (n=4), 0.8 (n=4). All files have notable=true.
